kxrce01.title: San Francisco: The Fog Ate the Plan
kxrce01.caption:
Virgo laminated a six-stop night. The fog had other plans.
The best part of the night was the stop nobody planned. Who in your group makes the itinerary?

kxrce02.title: Portland: The Friend Who Always Cancels
kxrce02.caption:
Cancer typed "rain check?" for the fourth time. The friends were already at the door.
Tag the friend who needs an umbrella for three.

kxtve01.title: Friday Night: Out All Night vs In by Nine
kxtve01.caption:
2016 Sagittarius: three parties and pancakes at 2 a.m.
2026 Sagittarius: in bed by nine, breakfast for the same crew. Which Friday are you living right now?
